details.method: Prepare the fixture contract digest and write its design from the same explicit UTF-8 bytes. Keep native raw-byte validation, and assert unique textual injection anchors when combining fixtures.
details.when: Integrating a Windows native design-confirmation consumer with parent contracts or restoring an original design after malformed-input checks.
details.counterexample: Path.write_text can translate LF to CRLF while the contract hashes LF; a previous normalized string rewrite can accidentally hide the mismatch. Loosening the product hash check would mask the real boundary.
details.trial_plan: In a future isolated consumer, confirm exact UTF-8 design bytes, then alter only line endings after confirmation and require rejection without dispatch; restore the original bytes, confirm anew, and require successful native continuation. Treat this proposal as a candidate until that explicit two-direction trial is recorded.
